newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Two new members appointed to Brierley board.
newsitem.headline: Two new members appointed to Brierley board.

text.p: Tan Sri Quek Leng Chan and Wong Kok Siew have accepted invitations to joint the board of Brierley Investments Ltd, the company said on Tuesday.

Tan Sri Quek Leng Chan is executive chairman of the Hong Leong Group Malaysia, a major shareholder of Camerlin Group Berhad which now holds the 20 percent shareholding in BIL acquired by a consortium of Asian based investors in March 1996. Wong is a director of the listed Singapore engineering and technology company Sembawang Corporation which is a major shareholder in Camerlin.
Bob Matthew, Chairman of BIL said he was delighted with the appointment of two these Asian business leaders had agreed to join the board.

"These additional non executive director appointments and the recently announced joint venture between Brierley and Camerlin much enhance our future prospects in the context of Asia's strong growth economies" he said.
